data.name: Enes
data.gender_notes: Enes is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Enes means strong and powerful in Bosnian and Turkish. In Albanian, it means 'brave, powerful, and strong'. The name Enes carries the meaning “Strong, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Bosnian, Turkish, Albanian. Parents who choose Enes usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Enes belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Enes total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: إِنۢس
in_arabic.long_meaning: إِنۢسُ: ذَكرىً مِنَ الأَنۢباءِ، وَقَد تَرَجَعُ إِلى نَبىً صَحِيحٍ تَصِفُ نَفَحَةً مِنَ النُبُوَّةِ. وَفِعْلٌ مِنَ الخُبَرِ، وَمِنَ الأَعجازِ. وَعِلمٌ بِالأَشياءِ وَالأَحوالِ، وَالأَزَمَةِ. وَأَرى النَفحَةَ مِنَ الإِِنۢسَانِ، وَالنَبىَ الصَحِيحَ. وَيُشَدَّدُ إِلى الصِدقِ، وَالصِدقُ إِلى الصِدقِ، وَالصِدقُ إِلى الحَقِّ، وَالنَبىُ الصَحِيحُ إِلى الحَقِّ. وَكَذَلِكَ يَقولُ النَبىُّ الصَحِيحُ: أَنَا حَقٌّ مِنَ اللَهِ، وَهَذا مَوَدَّعٌ بِالنَبىِّ الصَحِيحِ، وَإِنَّهُ يُشَدَّدُ إِلى الصِدقِ، وَالصِدقُ إِلى الصِدقِ، وَالصِدقُ إِلى الحَقِّ، وَالنَبىُ الصَحِيحُ إِلى الحَقِّ. وَكَذَلِكَ يَقولُ النَبىُّ الصَحِيحُ: مِنهُ نَبىٌ يُذَكَرُ عِندي، وَيُذَكَرُ عِندَكُمْ، وَهُوَ أَوَّلُ مَنِ اسْتَأَلَ اللَهُ العَلِيُّ مِنَ النَبىِّينَ.

In Islamic tradition, the name Enes is associated with the prophet Enes ibn Huzn, who was known for his truthfulness and sincerity. The name Enes is also mentioned in the Quran as a synonym for the word haqq, which means truth. In Islamic tradition, the name Enes is considered a symbol of truth, sincerity, and honesty.
